## What is this?

A Quarto extension that decorates code blocks with **named styles** —
diff, emphasis, custom — applied to **regions** (lines, columns, regex
tokens) across **steps** (revealjs fragments).

::: {.fragment}
Diff is one preset. The engine doesn't know what a diff is.
:::

## Quick taste

```{.r data-code-style="add:2-3, rem:5"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

## The gallery

- [`diff`](examples/diff.html) — add / rem / chg / note / hi
- [`emphasis`](examples/emphasis.html) — focus / dim / strong
- [`custom-styles`](examples/custom-styles.html) — define your own
- [`transitions`](examples/transitions.html) — timing, modes, presence
- [`tokens`](examples/tokens.html) — regex + column targeting
- [`annotations`](examples/annotations.html) — labels in the margin
- [`html-format`](examples/html-format.html) — works outside revealjs too

## Authoring

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
**Static block attribute**

```
{.r data-code-style="add:2-3, rem:5"}
df |>
  filter(cyl == 6) |>
  group_by(gear) |>
  summarise(m = mean(mpg)) |>
  arrange(desc(m))
```

:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
**YAML cell option**

```{{r}}
#| code-style:
#|   preset: emphasis
#|   - focus: 3
#|   - dim: [1-2, 4-5]
```

:::
:::

## Installation

```bash
quarto add EmilHvitfeldt/quarto-code-diff
```

Then in your YAML:

```yaml
format: code-style-revealjs
```
